issue.title: Error due to reference to inexistant sourcemap in prod build
issue.body:
### Versions
```
cli v6.0.0-rc.5
```

### Repro steps
* `npm install @angular/cli@next -g`
* `ng new helloworld`
* `cd helloworld`
* `ng g service-worker --project helloworld`
* `ng build --prod`

### Observed behavior
`ngsw-worker.js` contains a reference to a sourcemap:
`//# sourceMappingURL=ngsw_worker.es6.js.map`
but as we are in prod, the sourcemap is not here, and then it produces a message in console as the browser can't find the file.

### Desired behavior
No reference to sourcemaps in prod.

### Mention any other details that might be useful (optional)
Note that both `ngsw-worker.js` and `worker-basic.min.js` are not minified. It could mean that these scripts don't go through the normal prod build process, and thus the sourcemap issue.

body: Due to the [bazel build](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/packages/service-worker/BUILD.bazel#L29) just copying a dev generated file as is.

issue.title: cli builds for prod with --source-map=false and service workers enabled creates a referencing for ngsw_worker.es6.js.map
issue.body:
CLI builds for prod with --source-map=false and service workers enabled creates a referencing for ngsw_worker.es6.js.map . Should not reference `ngsw_worker.es6.js.map` in ngsw-worker.js when source maps are false.

### Versions
Angular CLI: 6.0.0
Node: 9.11.1
OS: linux x64
Angular: 6.0.0
... animations, cli, common, compiler, compiler-cli, core, forms
... http, language-service, platform-browser
... platform-browser-dynamic, router, service-worker

Package                           Version
-----------------------------------------------------------
@ angular-devkit/architect         0.6.0
@ angular-devkit/build-angular     0.6.0
@ angular-devkit/build-optimizer   0.6.0
@ angular-devkit/core              0.6.0
@ angular-devkit/schematics        0.6.0
@ angular/pwa                      0.6.0
@ ngtools/webpack                  6.0.0
@ schematics/angular               0.6.0
@ schematics/update                0.6.0
rxjs                              6.1.0
typescript                        2.7.2
webpack                           4.6.0

### Repro steps

* Build a production build using `ng build --prod --source-map=false --vendor-chunk=true --service-worker=true --extract-css=true --build-optimizer --aot`
* Run the distribution using http-server and serve in the browser
* On reload the service worker file looks to load `"GET /ngsw_worker.es6.js.map"`


### Observed behavior
NA

### Desired behavior

What would like to see implemented?
A --source-map=false should not create `ngsw_worker.es6.js.map` referencing

What is the usecase?
Production use without source maps

What did you expect to see?
NA


### Mention any other details that might be useful (optional)
NA

![ngsw-worker map](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3424344/39854378-1375ac38-5445-11e8-8d2e-d941ac4e4cda.png)

body: What should i do to avoid this error
Any news on that? same error here

To avoid this errors I had generared sourcemap of ngsw_worke.js manually (with Gulp), named it "ngsw_worker.es6.js.map" and placed to dist/browser directory. Of course, this is temporary issue, but I haven't another one.

Another workaround is to delete the reference to the source map. As @cyrilletuzi displayed above, removing following lines of `ngsw-worker.js` in your `dist` folder does the trick

    //# sourceMappingURL=ngsw_worker.es6.js.map

I like the fact that even the Angular Material website itself face that small bug ;)

For example opening the debugger console of https://material.angular.io/components/menu/overview will display the same warning
